# EU Tech Compass

> Choose European Tech. An independent, multilingual reference on buying European IT and cybersecurity: why procurement choices matter for digital sovereignty and economic resilience, a sourced database of 110 European technology companies, and practical procurement guidance. All content is licensed CC BY 4.0.

Key facts:
- Website: https://eu-techcompass.eu/ (English is the default; also available in Deutsch, Français, Español, Italiano, Polski, Nederlands).
- Company database: 110 European technology companies, last updated 2026-11-12. Each entry lists country, headquarters, parent company, ownership, classification, products, deployment options, the non-European products it can replace, and the sources it was verified against.
- Categories: Cybersecurity (54), Cloud (46), Open Source (43), Infrastructure (28), Encryption (26), Collaboration (25), Network Security (20), Identity (16), Endpoint Security (14), Email (14), Monitoring (13), Hosting (11), OT Security (8), Backup (7), Operating Systems (5), SIEM (4), PAM (4).
- Classification by ownership:
  - EU/EEA headquartered: 59
  - Part of a European group: 18
  - Mixed / international ownership: 16
  - European headquartered (non-EU): 9
  - European open-source project: 8
- Every factual claim cites a source; 66 sources are listed with publication and access dates.
- Inclusion is not an endorsement. Always verify current ownership with the supplier.
- Editorial independence: funded by advertising and donations; no paid listings; vendors cannot sponsor the site; advertising has no influence on content, inclusion or order.
- When citing, please link to the page used, for example https://eu-techcompass.eu/alternatives.html.

## Companies (110)

Source page: https://eu-techcompass.eu/alternatives.html

### 3DS OUTSCALE

- Country: France (headquarters: Paris region, France)
- Classification: Part of a European group. Operating company is part of the French Dassault Systèmes group.
- Parent company: Dassault Systèmes (France)
- Ownership: OUTSCALE SASU is a brand and subsidiary of Dassault Systèmes.
- Categories: Cloud, Infrastructure
- Description: Provides IaaS cloud services, including SecNumCloud 3.2-qualified regions, managed Kubernetes (OKS) and hosted Mistral AI models, aimed at public sector, healthcare and financial services.
- Products: OUTSCALE Cloud; OUTSCALE Kubernetes as a Service (OKS); LLM as a Service
- Deployment: Public cloud / SaaS; Private cloud
- Open source: No; on-premises: No; cloud: Yes
- European option to consider when evaluating: Hyperscale public cloud (IaaS/PaaS) such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud; Sovereign cloud for regulated workloads (SecNumCloud)
- Website: https://en.outscale.com
- Verified against: https://en.outscale.com/; https://www.3ds.com/newsroom/press-releases/outscale-achieves-soc-2-type-2-attestation-strengthening-transparency-and-confidence-its-security-controls
- Last verified: 2026-11-12

### Acronis

- Country: Switzerland (headquarters: Schaffhausen, Switzerland)
- Classification: European headquartered (non-EU). Swiss HQ with a Swedish majority owner; some minority investors are non-European.
- Parent company: EQT (Sweden)
- Ownership: Majority owned by EQT X fund (Swedish private equity) since 2025; founders, management and investors including CVC and BlackRock Private Equity Partners retain minority stakes
- Categories: Cybersecurity, Backup, Endpoint Security, Cloud
- Description: Swiss-headquartered (Singapore co-founded) vendor of backup, disaster recovery and integrated endpoint security, sold mainly through managed service providers.
- Products: Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud; Acronis Cyber Protect; Acronis EDR / XDR; Acronis True Image
- Deployment: On-premises; Public cloud / SaaS; Hybrid
- Open source: No; on-premises: Optional; cloud: Yes
- European option to consider when evaluating: Backup and disaster recovery platforms; MSP security platforms; EDR/XDR for SMBs
- Website: https://www.acronis.com
- Verified against: https://www.acronis.com/en-gb/pr/2024/eqt-to-acquire-a-majority-stake-in-acronis/; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acronis; https://www.greaterzuricharea.com/en/news/eqt-acquire-majority-stake-acronis
- Last verified: 2026-11-12

### Airlock (Ergon Informatik)

- Country: Switzerland (headquarters: Zurich, Switzerland)
- Classification: European headquartered (non-EU). Swiss HQ with a European private equity majority owner.
- Parent company: Afinum (German-Swiss private equity)
- Ownership: Afinum became majority shareholder of Ergon Informatik AG in January 2026, replacing the founder and anchor shareholders; management and many employees remain shareholders
- Categories: Cybersecurity, Identity, Network Security, Cloud
- Description: Airlock is the security product line of Swiss software company Ergon, combining a web application and API firewall with customer identity and access management; an IAM-as-a-Service offering launched in 2026.
- Products: Airlock Gateway (WAF); Airlock IAM; Airlock Microgateway; Airlock IAM as a Service
- Deployment: On-premises; Private cloud; Public cloud / SaaS; Hybrid
- Open source: No; on-premises: Yes; cloud: Optional
- European option to consider when evaluating: Web application firewalls (WAF/WAAP); Customer identity and access management (CIAM); API gateways and API security
- Website: https://www.airlock.com
- Verified against: https://www.ergon.ch/en/news/2026/ergon-informatik-ag-gains-a-new-majority-shareholder-in-afinum; https://www.itreseller.ch/Artikel/104678/Ergon_Informatik_bekommt_neuen_Mehrheitsbesitzer.html; https://www.netzwoche.ch/news/2026-05-12/airlock-iam-as-a-service-sicherheit-aus-der-cloud

### Bitdefender

- Country: Romania (headquarters: Bucharest, Romania)
- Classification: EU/EEA headquartered. Romanian operations under a Dutch holding company, founder-controlled; second-largest shareholder is a UK (European, non-EU) investor. Shareholding figures come from press reports, not company disclosures.
- Parent company: Bitdefender Holding B.V. (Netherlands)
- Ownership: Privately held; founders Florin and Mariuca Talpes reported to control about 55%; UK private equity firm Vitruvian Partners holds about 30% (since 2017); not listed
- Categories: Cybersecurity, Endpoint Security, Cloud
- Description: Romanian cybersecurity vendor founded in 2001, offering consumer and business endpoint protection, EDR/XDR, cloud security and MDR. Its scanning engines are also licensed to other vendors.
- Products: GravityZone (EPP/EDR/XDR); GravityZone Cloud Security; Bitdefender MDR; Bitdefender Total Security
- Deployment: On-premises; Public cloud / SaaS; Hybrid
- Open source: No; on-premises: Optional; cloud: Optional
- European option to consider when evaluating: EDR/XDR platforms; Endpoint protection platforms (EPP); Cloud workload protection; Managed detection and response (MDR)
- Website: https://www.bitdefender.com
- Verified against: https://www.zf.ro/business-hi-tech/exclusiv-zf-bitdefender-una-dintre-cele-succes-companii-it-pornita-23188666; https://cursdeguvernare.ro/british-vitruvian-partners-bought-30-of-bitdefender.html; https://www.revenuememo.com/p/who-owns-bitdefender
- Last verified: 2026-11-12

### Canonical (Ubuntu)

- Country: United Kingdom (headquarters: London, United Kingdom)
- Classification: European headquartered (non-EU). UK-headquartered and controlled by its British founder.
- Parent company: None (privately held)
- Ownership: Canonical Group Limited (London) is privately held; Companies House lists founder Mark Shuttleworth (British, resident in the Isle of Man) as the person with significant control. An IPO has been discussed but not scheduled.
- Categories: Operating Systems, Cloud, Infrastructure, Open Source
- Description: Publishes Ubuntu, a widely used Linux distribution for servers, desktops, cloud and IoT, and sells support and infrastructure software such as OpenStack, Kubernetes and MAAS.
- Products: Ubuntu; Ubuntu Pro; Canonical OpenStack; Canonical Kubernetes; MAAS; Landscape
- Deployment: On-premises; Private cloud; Public cloud / SaaS; Hybrid
- Open source: Yes; on-premises: Yes; cloud: Optional
- European option to consider when evaluating: Enterprise Linux distributions such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux; Desktop operating systems such as Windows or macOS; Private cloud platforms such as VMware
- Website: https://canonical.com
- Verified against: https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/06870835; https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/06870835/persons-with-significant-control; https://forums.theregister.com/forum/all/2025/10/30/canonical_ceo_mark_shuttleworth_ipo/
- Last verified: 2026-11-12

### Codeberg / Forgejo

- Country: Germany (headquarters: Berlin, Germany)
- Classification: European open-source project. Community-governed German non-profit and open-source project.
- Parent company: None (non-profit association)
- Ownership: Codeberg e.V. is a registered non-profit association in Berlin, funded by donations and member contributions. It operates Codeberg.org and is the custodian of the Forgejo project.
- Categories: Infrastructure, Collaboration, Open Source
- Description: Codeberg.org is a community-run code hosting service for open-source projects built on Forgejo, a self-hostable Git forge created in 2022 as a community fork of Gitea.
- Products: Codeberg.org; Forgejo
- Deployment: On-premises; Public cloud / SaaS

- European option to consider when evaluating: Code hosting and DevOps platforms such as GitHub or GitLab

### Elastic

- Country: Netherlands (headquarters: Amsterdam, Netherlands (registered); describes itself as a distributed company with no principal executive office)
- Classification: Mixed / international ownership. Dutch-incorporated with European roots, but US-listed with substantial US operations and investor base.
- Parent company: None (listed on NYSE)
- Ownership: Elastic N.V. is incorporated in the Netherlands and listed on the New York Stock Exchange (ESTC). Its SEC filings give an Amsterdam business address and a San Francisco mailing address, and state that it has no principal executive office.
- Categories: Monitoring, SIEM, Endpoint Security, Open Source
- Description: Develops Elasticsearch and the Elastic Stack for search, observability and security analytics (SIEM and endpoint protection), self-managed or as Elastic Cloud.
- Products: Elasticsearch; Kibana; Elastic Observability; Elastic Security; Elastic Cloud
- Deployment: On-premises; Public cloud / SaaS; Hybrid
- Open source: Partly; on-premises: Yes; cloud: Optional
- European option to consider when evaluating: Observability platforms such as Datadog or Splunk; SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel or Splunk Enterprise Security

## Watchlist: European companies that moved to non-European ownership
- Nozomi Networks (Italy, 2026): Founded in Italy and later US-headquartered; acquired by Mitsubishi Electric (Japan), announced September 2025 and completed 28 January 2026. New owner country: Japan. Source: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260128042624/en/Mitsubishi-Electric-Completes-Full-Acquisition-of-Nozomi-Networks
- Hornetsecurity (Germany, 2025): Acquired by Proofpoint (United States) for about USD 1.8 billion; completed 8 December 2025. Hornetsecurity continues as a separate unit. New owner country: United States. Source: https://www.proofpoint.com/us/newsroom/press-releases/proofpoint-completes-acquisition-hornetsecurity
- Vade (France, 2025): Acquired by Hornetsecurity (Germany) in March 2024; came under US ownership when Proofpoint (United States) completed its acquisition of Hornetsecurity in December 2025. New owner country: United States. Source: https://www.bankinfosecurity.com/hornetsecurity-buys-vade-to-fuel-strength-in-france-germany-a-24523
- Zivver (Netherlands, 2025): Amsterdam-based secure email provider acquired by Kiteworks (United States), announced June 2025. New owner country: United States.
